photo.credit: NASA / JPL-Caltech · Cassini Saturn Orbit Insertion (July 2004). Cassini's SOI was a textbook Oberth-effect maneuver — burning at periapsis around Saturn at ~30 km/s extracted the maximum energy per kilogram of propellant, capturing 5.6 tonnes of spacecraft into Saturn orbit.
